subject: 杭州闸口白塔
caption: 闸口白塔
九层仿木石塔 · 五代吴越
source_note: 九层实塔照片保留风化与残损檐角、仿木石刻和现有铁塔刹；原照片裁掉最下台基边缘，生成仅顺现存台基几何延伸至足部，未添新层。浮雕简化，不复原成完整木塔。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER ONLY: the existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant delicate slightly organic thin black strokes, restrained detail, large white surfaces and quiet visual density. Image 2 is an actual photograph of the NAMED MONUMENT and is GEOMETRY ONLY.
Create sparse fine BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, all surfaces and openings WHITE. Confident thin exterior contours and fewer finer interior structural lines. No solid black fills, no shadows, no gray shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, texture or gradients, no color. Simplify repetitive ornament; do not trace every brick, tile, rafter or weathered patch. Roof and wall surfaces should stay predominantly blank. Preserve the actual identifying geometry, proportions and present condition. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences, surrounding buildings and sky. No text, calligraphy, labels, captions, dimension marks, watermark or border. A few short ground strokes only.
Portrait 1024x1536, whole tower and base occupy about 82% of canvas height with margins, full apex and footings uncut; centered near-frontal with minimal perspective.
SUBJECT: Zhakou White Pagoda in Hangzhou, China, the actual Wuyue-period WHITE STONE miniature timber-imitation pagoda. Exactly NINE octagonal storeys, with NINE distinct stone eave roofs. Copy the actual tapered slender tower geometry in the photograph. Preserve the irregular weathered and partially broken stone eave corners and carved wooden-architecture imitations; do not restore it into a pristine wooden pagoda. Each of the nine storeys has a short wall body, carved false doors or simple deity reliefs and thin projecting stone eaves. The lowest storey is taller and more damaged, upper storeys become smaller. Include the large lower octagonal masonry platform and the narrower carved Sumeru/lotus pedestal, as well as the ENTIRE restored iron finial with round discs, ornamental openwork and bead-like upper tip. The pedestal is not an extra tower storey. Make all nine roof tiers distinct. Render the reliefs as very selective elegant thin outlines, all stone planes blank white, no dense carving or stone texture and no filled cracks. Keep the complete platform feet inside the frame even where the reference photograph crops its lowest edge; finish the existing simple platform geometry without adding new tiers. No intact giant tile roofs, no other towers, no trees or fences.

historical_sources.title: 杭州文物保护利用中心 · 闸口白塔
historical_sources.supports: 吴越末期，湖石雕砌仿木楼阁式塔，八面九层约14米，底部九山八海与须弥座，每层塔身、塔檐、平座三部分。

historical_sources.title: 杭州市文旅局 · The White Pagoda at Zhakou
historical_sources.supports: 五代十国吴越后期口径、八面九层、铁塔刹与佛菩萨浮雕；具体建造年份不据传说强填。

historical_sources.title: 杭州·白塔
historical_sources.publisher: 浙江省文物局（浙江文物网“古代高层建筑”专题），互联网档案馆存档
historical_sources.note: 八面九层仿木石塔、九山八海须弥座、束腰刻经、倚柱槏柱分三间、壶门、七朱八白、平座柱洞、塔刹毁、梁思成“雕塑品、模型”评语、吴越建塔鼎盛与《营造法式》

historical_sources.note: 魏祝挺据《咸淳临安志》考证白塔为957年钱弘俶所建安吴塔院之安吴塔、治平二年改普安院、“白塔”之名南宋初出现

site_recommendation.name: 闸口白塔
site_recommendation.year_note: 960仅为10世纪吴越后期的排序代表点，非经铭文确认的建造年。
site_recommendation.place: 浙江 · 杭州 · 白塔岭
site_recommendation.lede: 闸口白塔把楼阁木塔的柱枋、斗栱和层檐缩刻进白石之中。九层塔身由须弥座向上收分，风化石檐与铁塔刹共同勾勒钱塘江畔的吴越遗构。
facts: 文保资料将塔断在五代十国吴越后期，具体建造年尚不强定。
塔为八面九层仿木楼阁式石塔，每层由平座、塔身和塔檐组成。
基座刻九山八海与佛经，塔身有佛菩萨等浮雕；图版保留现状残损，未补成新塔。

quality_check.notes: 九个石檐层位可辨，铁刹、须弥座与台基足部完整，残损轮廓保留。
